_comment: REVIEWED NOTES — WHY A UTAH FILE IS EMPTY. Hand-written, not generated.
The Utah formal lane bands every member of its roster empty / thin / readable
(scripts/vr-utah-fpi.mjs). 'Empty' is the honest state of a file that holds no
formal act at all, and it is the one band a reader cannot interpret without
help: an empty file looks identical whether the person cast no admitted vote
in the sessions on file, left the Legislature before the earliest session, or
was seated after the latest one. Left unexplained, the blank reads as a verdict
on the person. It is not. It is a documentation status.
So each pid below carries ONE sentence saying why the formal record is empty,
written from facts already in the repo — the roster's own termStart/termEnd and
the reviewed findings in scripts/UTAH-LAUNCH-CLEANUP-TRACKER.md — and nothing
else. No note here characterises a record, ranks anybody, or implies that a
fuller file would have been better or worse. A note is not a score and is not
an input to one.
WHAT A NOTE MAY SAY. Five reason codes, and no sixth is invented to cover an
awkward case; a pid with no honest note is simply absent from this file and the
surface falls back to the plain empty state.
seated_after      seated after the last session on file, so there is no
session in the lane they could have voted in
left_before       out of the Legislature before the earliest session on file
candidate_only    on a ballot, never seated
federal           the id is a federal record; PolitiDex ingests no federal
roll calls, so a federal file is empty here by design
no_admitted_vote  sat during a session on file, but no vote of theirs cleared
the lane's admission rules (near-unanimity exclusion, an
unreviewed printed name, a refused mapping)
SESSIONS ON FILE when these notes were written: 2023GS, 2024GS, 2025GS. A note
that says 'seated after' or 'left before' is relative to that span and has to be
re-read when a session is added. That is why the span is stated here rather than
left implicit in each sentence.
Consumed by scripts/gen-formal-index.mjs, which copies these strings verbatim
into the shipped formal-index.js. Checked by scripts/test-empty-file-honesty.mjs.
